title: Correct the #5270 reference transcription at gate level (successor to #5349)
body:
## Change and scope

New package: `research/pr5270-reference-repair-20261023/`. It is the successor step to the audit merged as #5349, whose README named the first open step as correcting the bridge and idle transcription in a new package and comparing the corrected path against the formal controller.

The repair is a transformation of the emitted gate list, and nothing else:

1. The first 2(p−1) odd-role `BRIDGE` gates (the forward loop) have their endpoints swapped. Later odd bridges belong to the final reverse sweep. Their direction is already correct, so they stay as written.
2. `IDLE` gates tagged `middle` become identity, because thinning removes their even stages.
3. `IDLE` gates tagged `initial` or `terminal` have their power halved, because only the thick stages of each interval survive thinning.

The repaired list has the same gate count as the original. At p19 the repair touches 72 of 259 gates: 36 bridges swapped, 18 middle idles zeroed, 18 outer idles halved. In his review of the audit, @jwr404 noted that the initial idles share the terminal idle defect at p19, with nine retained. The outer correction covers both, and the p19 equality below includes all nine.

## Validation

CPython 3.12, Linux, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -B research/pr5270-reference-repair-20261023/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/pr5270-reference-repair-20261023/verify.py
```

Both modes pass. For every p from 2 to 19, at the audit specialization (q=1, odd stage letters i, even stage letters 1):

- The original gate list, read by a plain interpreter with no correction flags, differs from the formal thinned controller. The mismatch count at p19 is 351, the audit's number.
- The repaired gate list, read by the same interpreter, equals the formal controller exactly. Mismatches after repair are 0 at every p.
- Leaving out any one of the three corrections breaks the equality at p=2, p=3 and p=19. All nine negative controls are rejected.

The vendor files are byte-identical to the pins in the audit package. `RESULT.json` records the full per-p table.

## Scope limits

This is the transcription step only. Binding one actual rank-eight native reverse invocation with its independent blocks, then recalculating the complete invoice, remain open in the audit's stated order. No new κ is claimed.

The audit package and its retained lineage are credited in the package README: DaysSky, Cayden Burkart / SethBurkart123, Dillon, Dugongue / mdumitrean, Cinna Davis, Cao Yifan, zxv and Jacob Alan Sussman.
